title: galeopsis ladanum var. nana
intro: Galeopsis ladanum var. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Lad's Love or Dwarf Hempnettle, is a variety of the Galeopsis ladanum plant. It is a flowering plant in the mint family, known for its small purple flowers and square stems. The health benefits of Galeopsis ladanum var. nana include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use as an antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
